Description: Verify that the system automatically opens the gate at the scheduled irrigation time.
Pre-condition: A valid irrigation schedule exists and the gate is operational.
Action: Wait until the scheduled irrigation time.
Expected Results: Gate opens automatically at the scheduled time.
Actual Results: At 06:00 gate 1 status = CLOSED | Problem: False is not true : Gate 1 did not open automatically at 06:00
Post-Condition: Gate status is updated to Open.

Description: Verify that the system automatically closes the gate when the irrigation period ends.
Pre-condition: Gate is open and an irrigation schedule is active.
Action: Wait until the irrigation period ends.
Expected Results: Gate closes automatically when the scheduled period ends.
Actual Results: Problem: False is not true : Gate 1 was not open during the irrigation period
Post-Condition: Gate status is updated to Closed.

Expected Results: The system identifies a potential leak and generates an alert.

Expected Results: No leak alert is generated based on the greater-than-8.0 threshold.
Actual Results: Sensor 2 flow 8.0, status Normal, alerts created = 0

Description: Verify that an authenticated user can acknowledge a leak alert.

Actual Results: Alert acknowledged; alert status = Acknowledged
